title: Keith's crown matches its photographs: pointed stones and a carved boss
items: At 1808 Prairie, the band under the rooftop lattice is now five rows of small pointed stones set in a checker, as the 1888 and 1948 photographs show it. The taller band of large rough blocks is gone, and plain stone runs below it down to a moulding.
A carved round boss now stands on the north-east corner where the moulding under the lattice ends.
The lattice's openings sit lower under a deeper solid top, and the deep projecting band beneath the lattice is now a thin ledge.
